title: Reduce Completed pilot evidence helper exports
summary: Removed five transitional flat window.* aliases for Completed pilot-evidence helper functions and moved the Sample Validation completed-packet handoff to read those helpers through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView.
reason: Continue namespace-first WebView cleanup in a scoped Completed/Sample Validation handoff slice while preserving intentional flat compatibility hooks still used by Pending Publish and browser smokes.
behavior_before: Sample Validation completed-packet handoff read Completed pilot-evidence helpers through direct window.completedPilotEvidence* flat aliases, and completedView.js exported those helpers both through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView and as flat window.* aliases.
behavior_after: Sample Validation completed-packet handoff reads Completed pilot-evidence helpers through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView, and completedView.js keeps those helper functions namespace-only. The renderCompletedPilotEvidencePacket flat hook remains because Pending Publish still calls it directly.
tests_added: Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_completed_pending_proof_smoke.py to require the removed pilot-evidence helper names through mediaPipelineCompletedView and to assert the served Completed source no longer assigns those flat aliases.

Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_sample_validation_smoke.py to assert the Sample Validation records source no longer reads the removed Completed pilot-evidence helpers through flat window.* aliases.
rollback_plan: Revert this change packet to restore the five direct Completed pilot-evidence helper window.* aliases, restore Sample Validation records flat-helper lookups, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and restore the prior flat export counts in docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md and docs/inventories/WEBVIEW_GLOBAL_EXPORT_INVENTORY.md.
